task.title: HTTPS示例
task.shortdesc: 该小结将通过GET请求描述HTTPS使用步骤。

p.codeblock:
SSL证书写入：

创建实例和参数配置 AT+MHTTPCREATE="https://120.27.12.119:10443" +MHTTPCREATE: 0 OK AT+MHTTPCFG="ssl",0,1,1 //HTTPS使能 OK
GET请求： AT+MHTTPREQUEST=0,1,1,"/get" OK +MHTTPURC: "header",0,200,225,HTTP/1.1 200 OK Server: nginx/1.18.0 Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2021 06:52:49 GMT Content-Type: application/json Content-Length: 145 Connection: keep-alive Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true +MHTTPURC: "content",0,145,145,145,{"args":{},"headers":{"Connection":"close","Content-Length":"0","Host":"localhost:6000"},"origin":"127.0.0.1","url":"http://localhost:6000/get"}
